Flat 3C Mini

Simple Feels Better

Palm-Sized 5-Inch Phone—Easy to Hold and Love.

DESIGN & COLORS

Fits Your Palm. Feels Just Right.

A compact 5-inch design made for natural one-hand use—small, familiar, and effortlessly capable. Clean lines and softly refined edges shape a modern, minimal form that feels balanced in everyday life. Less like a smartphone. More like a small everyday object—about the size of a palm, or a small orange.

Minimal look

Designed for simple, clean everyday aesthetics.

Effortless everyday carry

Light, compact, and always ready to go.

Comfortable grip

Two Colors. Pick Your Mood.

Light. Slim. Effortless.

Weighing just 158.5 g with a slim, compact form, OSCAL FLAT 3C Mini feels light in your hand and easy to slip into your pocket. Clean lines and a modern finish create an effortlessly stylish look, while a comfortable grip and lightweight build make it easy to carry anywhere.

Capture Life, Simply

Designed for quick everyday moments, the camera system lets you snap, record, and share without overthinking. Because sometimes the best memories happen fast.

Press Fast. Catch More.

Some moments don't wait.
With a dedicated side button built into the power key, FLAT 3C Mini launches the camera instantly with a simple double press—no unlocking, no searching, no delay. From pocket to camera in an instant. So you’re always ready when it matters.

Press. Record. Capture Life

From family gatherings to everyday life, capture and share your moments easily—just press record and go.

With a removable 3000mAh battery, FLAT 3C Mini gives you more freedom in how you power through the day. Charge normally when you want — or swap in a fresh battery and get back to what matters without waiting beside a charger. Perfect for commuting, travel, long days out, or simply keeping backup power ready when you need it.
